title: Comparing Domain-Model Similarity Metrics Against Human Expert Ratings
abstract: arXiv:2608.15250v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Domain models are a primary artefact in model-driven software engineering, where they capture the shared understanding between stakeholders and serve as the contractual basis for downstream software development. Automatic comparison of these semantic models has diverse application areas such as requirements engineering, education, automatic generation of domain models and model reuse and repository mining. The literature offers a variety of presented metrics, but for practitioners there is no defensible way to choose between them. The contribution of this paper is the implementation of five such metrics, their execution on a fixed set of 39 domain-model comparisons and the comparison of each metric's output against the human expert ratings produced for the same comparisons. translated_title: 对比领域模型相似性度量与人类专家评分
translated_abstract: 领域模型是模型驱动软件工程中的主要工件，它们捕捉利益相关者之间的共享理解，并作为下游软件开发的合同基础。这些语义模型的自动比较在需求工程、教育、领域模型的自动生成以及模型重用和仓库挖掘等多个应用领域具有广泛用途。文献中提出了各种度量方法，但对于实践者来说，没有可靠的方法在它们之间进行选择。本文的贡献是实现了五种这样的度量，在固定的一组39个领域模型比较上执行它们，并将每个度量的输出与为相同比较产生的人类专家评分进行比较。研究提出了两个问题。RQ1询问在39个比较中，每个度量平均接近人类专家评分的程度。RQ2询问每个度量的输出一致性如何。
tldr: 本文通过实现五种领域模型相似性度量并与人类专家评分在39组比较上进行验证，为实践者选择最合适的度量提供了实证依据。
en_tdlr: This paper implements five domain-model similarity metrics and validates them against human expert ratings on 39 comparisons, providing empirical evidence for practitioners to choose the most suitable metric.
